queue.title: Oil prices head higher on fears of more strikes on Iran
queue.excerpt: Brent crude rose 0.7% to $92.63 a barrel. Prices earlier swung between small gains and losses as Trump and his Chinese and Russian counterparts agreed to ramp up global fuel supplies.
